# Saurabh Upadhyay

> Flutter developer in Mumbai, India (IST). He builds, releases and supports his own Android apps and developer tools. Also known as Saurabh Rajkamal Upadhyay; handle Saurabh-7973 on GitHub and Google Play, Saurabh7973 on Medium.

Everything listed here is live and can be checked at the links. The same facts are in machine-readable form in his resume.json.

## Products

- [Guidester](https://saurabhupadhyay.in/guidester): in-app tester feedback for Flutter. Testers tap the spot that's wrong and type; the comment reaches a dashboard with a screenshot, the screen name and the device. Flutter package on [pub.dev](https://pub.dev/packages/guidester) (MIT), Flutter web dashboard, self-hosted Supabase backend.
- [Snapdrop: Phone to Figma](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.getsnapdrop.app): Android app and Figma plugin; scan the plugin's QR code and send up to ten photos into Figma. Not related to the snapdrop.net file-sharing web app.
- [Sanatan Guide](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Saurabh7973.sanatan_guide): offline Android reader for the Bhagavad Gita, the Vedas and the Upanishads.
- [Sahaj](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.saurabh7973.sahaj): guided men's wellness training app for Android, with in-app purchases.
